$comment: F-R10. The same blocks through both block->text projections: Geek-Crawler-Rag block_text.render_block_text (Python, `python`) and GeekAPI GccCorpusBlockMapper.MapBlocks (C#, `csharp`). Where `differs` is null the two must be byte-equal and `csharp` is omitted. Where it is set, the difference is one of exactly two kinds, both present in the corpus on 2026-10-04 (36,090 rows with empty cells; 28 prose blocks with escaped markup), and POST /v1/verify normalises exactly those (citation_verify.verify_quote). Each repo's test pins its own projection against its own copy; the cross-repo workflow requires the two copies to be byte-identical. Cases are single runs of blocks that C# turns into paragraphs; headings are omitted because C# emits no paragraph for them.
